Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, Plants of the World Online: Goeppertia

tr.description: Kalatya (Calathea, Goeppertia) bakımı: az–orta dolaylı ışık, düzenli nem, yumuşak su, yüksek nem ve ASPCA'nın toksik değil kaydı.
tr.imageAlt: Orman zemininde büyüyen, koyu ve açık yeşil şeritli kalatya yaprakları
tr.caption: Fotoğraf: Goeppertia zebrina, Cricket Raspet, iNaturalist üzerinden, CC BY 4.0. Yeniden boyutlandırıldı.

atAGlance.light: Dolaylı, orta ile az ışık; doğrudan güneş yaprağı yakar
atAGlance.watering: Harcı hafif nemli tut, asla çamurlaştırma; yüzeyi sık kontrol et
atAGlance.humidity: Yüksek; çakıllı tepsi veya nemli oda yardımcı olur
atAGlance.temperature: Yaklaşık 18–24 °C; cereyandan ve ani değişimlerden koru
atAGlance.petSafety: ASPCA kedi ve köpekler için toksik değil olarak listeler (Calathea)

en.description: Calathea (Goeppertia) care: low to medium indirect light, steady moisture, soft water, humidity and the ASPCA non-toxic listing.
en.imageAlt: Calathea leaves striped with dark and light green bands, growing on the forest floor
en.caption: Photo: Goeppertia zebrina by Cricket Raspet, via iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Resized.

atAGlance.light: Indirect, medium to low light; direct sun scorches leaves
atAGlance.watering: Keep the mix lightly moist, never soggy; check the surface often
atAGlance.humidity: High; a pebble tray or humid room helps
atAGlance.temperature: About 18–24 °C (65–75 °F); avoid draughts and sudden changes
atAGlance.petSafety: Listed as non-toxic to cats and dogs by the ASPCA (Calathea)

es.description: Cuidados de la calathea (Goeppertia): luz indirecta media o baja, humedad constante, agua blanda, ambiente húmedo y estado según la ASPCA.
es.imageAlt: Hojas de calathea con franjas verde oscuro y verde claro, creciendo en el suelo del bosque
es.caption: Foto: Goeppertia zebrina de Cricket Raspet, vía iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Redimensionada.

atAGlance.light: Luz indirecta, de media a baja; el sol directo quema las hojas
atAGlance.watering: Sustrato ligeramente húmedo, nunca encharcado; revisa la superficie a menudo
atAGlance.humidity: Alta; ayuda una bandeja con guijarros o una habitación húmeda
atAGlance.temperature: Unos 18–24 °C; evita corrientes y cambios bruscos
atAGlance.petSafety: La ASPCA la incluye como no tóxica para gatos y perros (Calathea)

de.description: Korbmarante (Calathea, Goeppertia) pflegen: mittleres bis wenig indirektes Licht, gleichmäßige Feuchte, weiches Wasser und ASPCA-Einstufung.
de.imageAlt: Calathea-Blätter mit dunkel- und hellgrünen Streifen auf dem Waldboden
de.caption: Foto: Goeppertia zebrina von Cricket Raspet, über iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Verkleinert.

atAGlance.light: Indirekt, mittel bis wenig Licht; direkte Sonne verbrennt die Blätter
atAGlance.watering: Substrat leicht feucht halten, nie nass; Oberfläche oft prüfen
atAGlance.humidity: Hoch; Kiesschale oder feuchter Raum hilft
atAGlance.temperature: Etwa 18–24 °C; Zugluft und plötzliche Wechsel vermeiden
atAGlance.petSafety: Von der ASPCA als ungiftig für Katzen und Hunde geführt (Calathea)

pt.description: Cuidados com a calathea (Goeppertia): luz indireta média a baixa, umidade constante, água sem cloro, ar úmido e a classificação da ASPCA.
pt.imageAlt: Folhas de calathea com faixas verde-escuras e verde-claras, crescendo no chão da mata
pt.caption: Foto: Goeppertia zebrina de Cricket Raspet, via iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Redimensionada.

atAGlance.light: Luz indireta, média a baixa; sol direto queima as folhas
atAGlance.watering: Substrato levemente úmido, nunca encharcado; confira a superfície com frequência
atAGlance.humidity: Alta; bandeja com pedrinhas ou cômodo úmido ajudam
atAGlance.temperature: Cerca de 18–24 °C; evite correntes de ar e mudanças bruscas
atAGlance.petSafety: A ASPCA lista como não tóxica para gatos e cães (Calathea)

fr.description: Entretien du calathea (Goeppertia) : lumière indirecte moyenne à faible, humidité régulière, eau douce, air humide et classement ASPCA.
fr.imageAlt: Feuilles de calathea rayées de vert foncé et de vert clair, au sol en sous-bois
fr.caption: Photo : Goeppertia zebrina de Cricket Raspet, via iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Redimensionnée.

atAGlance.light: Lumière indirecte, moyenne à faible ; le soleil direct brûle les feuilles
atAGlance.watering: Substrat légèrement frais, jamais détrempé ; vérifier souvent la surface
atAGlance.humidity: Élevée ; plateau de billes ou pièce humide
atAGlance.temperature: Environ 18–24 °C ; éviter courants d’air et changements brusques
atAGlance.petSafety: Classé non toxique pour les chats et les chiens par l’ASPCA (Calathea)
